authority_boundary.action_executor: LIVING_RUNTIME_APPLY_ACTION remains sole authoritative mutation executor for this stage

agent_brain.truth_rule: PERCEPTION_IS_NON_AUTHORITATIVE; AgentBrain target selection never queries target truth to correct a belief
agent_brain.decision_intent_atomicity: decision record and candidate intent commit together or neither exists

action_policy.offline_authorial_rule: ROUTINE_OFFLINE accepts only SYSTEM_ROUTINE or SYSTEM_RECOVERY intents whose policy is ROUTINE_SAFE
action_policy.cooldown: stored as authoritative actor state in same action transaction
action_policy.mutation_template_rule: mutation targets and field paths are policy-authored fixed values; candidate intent cannot supply mutation field path or consequence target

protection_inference.TARGET lifecycle DEAD: DEATH impact inferred even if policy author omitted declaration
protection_inference.TARGET lifecycle DESTROYED: WORLD_MUTATION impact inferred even if policy author omitted declaration

concurrency.lock_order: AgentBrain -> IntentValidator -> LivingRuntime for decision+intent atomic section
concurrency.validated_action_preconditions: actor and resolved target entity versions captured at validation
concurrency.race_resolution: stale competing execution fails transactionally by version precondition rather than overselling/overwriting
concurrency.idempotency: one runtime action id per successful validation; core idempotency key is intent:<intent_id>

integrity.fail_closed_guard: corruption detected by integrity_guard changes world status to CORRUPT_BLOCKED
integrity.core_integrity_dependency: validator guard also consumes LivingRuntime full_integrity_check
